target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Promotes Ohio's First Summer Resort Town with 150 years of year-round fun. Geneva-on-the-Lake is Ashtabula County's premier lakefront destination with famous entertainment strip, north shore, 30+ wineries in Ohio Wine Country. Offers diverse experiences: nightlife/live music, family fun, lake activities, fishing charters, seasonal charm (St. Patrick's to Christmas). Positioned as 'Nostalgic Beach Bum Charm' with Lake Life experiences. Trip planning tools would enhance visitor engagement and extend length of stay.

target_buyer_2.type: Local Tour Operator (Wine & Covered Bridge Tours)
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Specialized tour operator offering covered bridge tours (Ashtabula County's 19 fascinating covered bridges including nation's longest and shortest) and winery tours. Classy wine tours with great music, not pub crawls. Bachelorette party specialists. Also offers specialty tours: breweries, antiquing, ball games, concerts, shopping. Rates from $55-60 per guest. Integrated trip planner with booking would streamline their operations and enhance customer experience.
